Method of Attack: Exploits Webmin RCE vulnerability CVE-2019-15107 to drop downloader module
Supports reverse shell, self uninstall, system command execution
Harvesting and exfiltrating process and network information
Runs encrypted payloads from remote URLs
Launches DDoS attacks (ICMP Flood, HTTP Flood, TCP Flood, UDP Flood)
Uses P2P control and vulnerability scanner modules
Uses cryptographic algorithms (Curve25519, Ed25519, TEA, SHA256, HMAC-SHA256) for integrity and security
Creates Linux self-starting scripts and disguises files/process names for persistence
Impacted Systems: Linux servers running unpatched Webmin installations
Attack Vector: Exploitation of Webmin RCE vulnerability CVE-2019-15107
Indicators of Compromise: Downloader module dropped on compromised Linux servers
